prompts.cover: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: novel cover for No Vacancy, portrait 9:16, exactly 864x1536 pixels. Render exact title 'No Vacancy' ONCE within the painting, large legible warm ivory serif letters in the quiet upper area. No author text or other text. Canadian Group of Seven inspired oil painting, matching supplied orchard reference for broad rhythmic colour shapes, directional opaque strokes, selective impasto, connected shadows and lost edges; no glossy digital rendering or theatrical rim light. Composition: an elderly ordinary medium brindled brown mixed-breed dog with almost-white muzzle, brown eyes, dog's left ear floppy and right semi-pricked, standing near a low wooden handcart with a worn cushion and blanket at a green hedge beside a modest old school gate. A slender thirteen-year-old pupil in a plain clean skirt and blue coat rolled in the cart is seen mostly from behind beside the dog; restrained figure, not a portrait. Above the gate, a small distant pupil rises near a school roof with a starling ahead, modest understated morning light. The emotional centre is the dog's attentive nose and the student's hand on the cart, with space above that feels both inviting and out of reach. Coherent scale, ordinary dog anatomy and stiff hindquarters, no dog wings, magical glow, halo or heroic pose. Motivated cool morning light, green hedge, stone and warm brown dog, subdued natural colours. This is a cover of comic hurt, curiosity and affection, not a tragic death scene. Supplied reference image is for brushwork only, not scene contents.
